verdict.rationale: Obsidian's mobile page says Obsidian Mobile 'brings the power of our desktop app to your mobile devices' and lists tabs, Command Palette and plugins on mobile. The help docs describe a customizable mobile editing toolbar, and a community report confirms real Android use. That directly addresses the 'not a stripped-down companion' core, though one Android user reports deferred saves that lost trailing lines and broke git sync mid-edit, a capture-reliability caveat. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that search and linking work on mobile, named iOS coverage, independent corroboration of desktop parity, and evidence the Android save/data-loss issue is resolved.
